title: RetailIQ AI V2 — Executive Operational Decision Strategy

priority_executive_directives.directive: Implement Dynamic Safety Buffers for Tier 2 Volatile Powerhouses
priority_executive_directives.action: Increase safety stock buffers from 8% to 18% and enable 75 weekly flex hours for weekend volume surges.
priority_executive_directives.expected_outcome: Reduces stockout-driven revenue loss during high-volatility holiday periods by an estimated 14%.

priority_executive_directives.directive: Automate Lean Inventory Flow for Tier 1 Core Performers
priority_executive_directives.action: Shift replenishment entirely to model-driven weekly automated ordering with lean 8% buffer.
priority_executive_directives.expected_outcome: Unlocks working capital and prevents warehouse staging overstock.

priority_executive_directives.directive: Execute Targeted Merchandising Audits on High-Return Departments
priority_executive_directives.action: Initiate vendor packaging reviews and deploy 20% -> 40% clearance ladders for aging inventory.
priority_executive_directives.expected_outcome: Curtails merchandise degradation and recovers shelf velocity.

priority_executive_directives.directive: Rationalize Assortment in Tier 4 Turnaround Stores
priority_executive_directives.target: 14 Stores with below-median sales and high forecast error
priority_executive_directives.action: Draw down slow-moving Class D SKUs by 25% and consolidate shelf space around Top 15 anchor departments.
priority_executive_directives.expected_outcome: Improves inventory turn rate and lowers shrinkage across underperforming units.
